title: Lake Havasu City, AZ — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Lake Havasu City, AZ: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Lake Havasu City is a city in AZ with a population of 57,000. Colorado River resort town famous for the London Bridge and year-round water sports. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 10a growing zone supports Hot — tropical and subtropical crops, year-round growing. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 300 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 55.7.
